evidence_refs.quote: I'll get it signed on our side.

expected.label: SINGLE_THREADED_RISK
expected.rationale: Replying only to Priya is defensible because she explicitly said she would get the form signed, but at the signature stage the signer and approval path remain unknown and the economic buyer is uncovered. No named gating stakeholder is being omitted, so this does not meet the blocking rule.
The approver is still unnamed, but finance approved the spend in writing on 09-03; per the catalog rule that is a warn, not a fail (same reading as acme_cp4_k21_budget_already_approved_trap).

As of 09-15 the signature path is explicitly unconfirmed (CRM note 09-10: 'until the signature path is confirmed') and nobody has said who signs for Acme Logistics B.V.; a signature push that does not ask who signs or what approvals remain skips the paper process.
expected.debate_note: Priya volunteered to get it signed; some reviewers would accept a champion-driven signature ask as a warn and not block it.

expected_best_action.why: Thank Priya and ask who signs on the EU entity and whether any other approval (security, procurement) is needed before signature.

notes: Judged only on what is known at 09-15 (no hindsight). K21 reading: spend is approved in writing, so K21 does not apply and economic_buyer_coverage is a warn; the paper process is a separate decision_process question. Same reading in acme_cp4_k21_budget_already_approved_trap.
